Girdwood Land Use Committee
                  Notice of Meeting on October 13, 2025 7PM
                              Minutes Final
Meeting will take place via Teams teleconference and in person at the Girdwood Community Room, 250 Egloff Rd.

The following items have been submitted as agenda items for consideration at the meeting of the Girdwood Land Use Committee. A
voting member is any Girdwood Valley resident eighteen (18) years of age or older. Non-resident property owners, businesses, and
non-profit associations are allowed one (1) vote per entity. Detailed voting qualifications can be found in the rules outlined in the
Girdwood Land Use Committee Operating Principles.

The Girdwood Board of Supervisors, its committees, and subcommittees are subject to the Alaska Open Meetings Act as found in
Alaska Statute 44.62.310 and Anchorage Municipal Code1.25 - Public Meetings.
The Girdwood Land Use Committee operates under the Girdwood Public Meetings Standards of Conduct.

Agenda Item LUC 2510-01:
Land Acknowledgement: As we gather with a common intention for our GVSA this evening, LUC would like to begin by acknowledging
the stewardship of the indigenous peoples of Alaska, whose land we reside on and the surrounding waters we depend on.
The current area of Girdwood is situated between the areas known to be Dena'ina and Alutiiq homeland. A necessary connection for
Alaska Native people, the landscape and waters around us served to carry their traditional ways of life; to gather here and harvest
Native foods. The community of Girdwood respects the Dena'ina and Alutiiq people, who were stewards of this land for generations.
We will continue to be stewards of this land and are grateful to be a part of this community.

7PM Call to order Ryan Hutchins-Cabibi

        Girdwood Land Use Committee Meeting Agendas and minutes are available on line: http://www.muni.org/gbos

Agenda Item LUC 2509-05: Liquor License renewals for 2026. Community Councils may request legislative public hearing on renewals
within their boundaries by adopting a resolution requesting such action by October 15, 2025. If no such action is requested, LUC to
consider requesting GBOS Letter of Non Objection covering renewals in 2026.(Staff/Wingard)

Motion:
LUC moves to recommend GBOS Letter of non-objection for liquor license renewals as presented.
Motion by Brice W/2nd A Tuttle
Motion carries by assent

Agenda Item LUC 2407-04: Consider Municipal STR registration and regulation compared to proposed Girdwood STR registration.
Review New MOA STR tax proposal, amendments and draft Letter of Objection. (Wingard/Edgington)
Review new Registration AO
LUC has previously objected to the un-amended STR tax proposal. Amendments have not yet been addressed/accepted or declined.
GBOS has drafted Letter of Objection but has not sent it yet, pending final proposed AO. Tax option, if accepted by Assembly, would go
to an areawide vote in the spring election.

Motion:
LUC moves to recommend Letter of Objection to GBOS
Motion by Brice W. No second. Motion fails

Agenda Item LUC 2507-05: Request for LUC recommendation for GBOS Resolution of Support for HLB to initiate a Site Specific Land
Use Study before any development is initiated in Girdwood. (formerly Agenda Item LUC 2406-04, closed 10.24) (Tuttle)
No update. Amanda Tuttle will redraft request.

New Business:
Agenda Item LUC 2510-04: Consider recommendations for GBOS input to HLB Annual work program and 5 year management plan.
 2026_HLBWorkPlan_DRAFT_20250930_PublicReview.pdf
LUC is encouraged to review the draft plan and provide comments either directly to HLB or via LUC. Comment period ends prior to
GBOS meeting in November. Staff will request extension so that GBOS can make formal comment.

Agenda Item LUC 2510-05: Discussion and formation of a request regarding street lights/dark night considerations within the on-site
Holtan Hills Subdivision (Wingard).
Light pollution is a concern of new development of Holtan Hills. Developer seems open to possibility of less lighting of the street than is
typical in Anchorage. Off-site improvements (ie road from Hightower to edge of new development property line will have street lights as
required by code.
On-site lighting of the new road within the new neighborhood could be pared down to something more similar to Verbier Rd lighting – ie
intersection lighting and intermittent lights otherwise. It is noted that private home lighting would need to be addressed in HOA
requirements.

Agenda Item LUC 2510-06: Federation of Community Council Bylaws and Girdwood Representative
During discussions of FCC Bylaw re-write, discussion of Girdwood participation has come up. Years ago LUC agenda included item to
find volunteer to participate at FCC but no one volunteered. GBOS member who brought the need for volunteer forward agreed to
continue. Since that time there has been little discussion of FCC at Girdwood public meetings. Bylaws re-write has brought some
questions to light about that individual’s participation at FCC. FCC amended bylaws vote is apparently scheduled for this week.

Some state that the FCC operation is redundant to the Girdwood staff work. Role of FCC is different for small neighborhood councils,
but Girdwood system has different, more robust role.

Motion:
LUC moves to temporarily appoint Brice Wilbanks to represent Girdwood at the Federation of Community Councils Meeting.
Motion by J Wingard/2nd A Tuttle
Motion carries by Assent vote

Motion:
LUC moves to write a letter affirming Brice Wilbanks as the temporary appointed representative to FCC.
Motion by J Wingard/2nd A Tuttle
Motion carries by Assent vote

Jennifer Wingard agrees to write the letter.

Agenda Item LUC 2510-07: Solid Waste Services Fee increase. Assembly increased fees starting in September for trash disposal at
SWS. These funds are used to help pay for city crew that clears parks of homeless camps with Healthy Spaces team. Girdwood staff
confirms that Healthy Spaces team has worked in Girdwood to assist with camp cleanup.

Request for GBOS/LUC Joint Meeting (1 of 2 completed in 2025, Jan 13): Holtan Hills CU/PUD meeting schedule Oct 21 at 7PM.
Adjourn         9PM
